title.zh: 为 Naga 市市法院增设一名法官，并为此修订该市宪章第75条的法案
title.en: An Act Providing One Additional Judge for the City Court of the City of Naga, Amending for the Purpose Section Seventy-Five of the Charter of Said City
title.orig: An Act Providing One Additional Judge for the City Court of the City of Naga, Amending for the Purpose Section Seventy-Five of the Charter of Said City

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5328_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The first paragraph of Section seventy-five of Republic Act Numbered Three hundred five, otherwise known as the Charter of the City of Naga, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 75. Regular, auxiliary and acting judges of city court.— There shall be a city court for the City of Naga, for which there shall be appointed two city judges and auxiliary city judge."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
